title: When the Atlas Turns
author: Edmund Voss
blurb: Elodie Ashgrove, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
